formats.name: 25-Word Monero Legacy (Electrum v2)
formats.checksum_algorithm: CRC-32 of concatenated 3-character prefixes of first 24 words modulo 24
formats.spend_key_derivation: b = decode_base1626_le32(words[0..23]) (already reduced mod l at generation)

formats.name: 16-Word Polyseed
formats.checksum_algorithm: Galois field GF(2048) polynomial Reed-Solomon code (11 bits)

formats.name: 13-Word MyMonero Legacy
formats.checksum_algorithm: CRC-32 of concatenated 3-character prefixes of first 12 words modulo 12
formats.view_key_derivation: a = sc_reduce32(keccak256(h1))  [Hashes unreduced h1, NOT b]

formats.name: 12-Word Exodus Style (BIP-39)
formats.checksum_algorithm: 4-bit SHA-256 prefix embedded in the 12th word
formats.spend_key_derivation: seed64 = PBKDF2_HMAC_SHA512(mnemonic, 'mnemonic'); k = BIP32(seed64, "m/44'/128'/account'/0/0"); b = sc_reduce32(k)
supported_wallets: Any 25-word wallet after re-encoding b as 25 Monero words

formats.name: 24-Word Hardware / Coinomi Style (BIP-39)
formats.checksum_algorithm: 8-bit SHA-256 prefix embedded in the 24th word
formats.spend_key_derivation: Hardware app derives slip10/bip32 node at m/44'/128'/0'/0/0 and hashes with Keccak-256 before sc_reduce32
supported_wallets: Ledger Monero App (with Monero GUI/CLI, Feather, Cake, Monerujo)
